objective.name: sandbox.py.runtime.info
objective.description: Interpreted wrapper-backed runtime inspection capacity for Execution N6 tests

#root.role: Return runtime information about the interpreted wrapper environment and execution workspace.

effects.wrapper_runtime: The interpreted wrapper runtime may be started lazily.

transformation_contract.morphing: A runtime inspection request becomes an explicit snapshot of the interpreted wrapper execution environment.
invariants: sandbox.py.runtime.info must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: sandbox.py.runtime.info returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: sandbox.py.runtime.info fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.
